---
title: "The OpenPipeline ecosystem"
description: "Get to know the OpenPipeline packages."
order: 10
---

OpenPipeline consists of a core package with extension packages for specific domains and processing steps.
Each package uses [Viash](viash.qmd) so components, data format and tooling are shared between them.

| Package | Role |
|---|---|
| [`openpipeline`]{.pkg-tag .pkg-openpipeline}<span class="swatch openpipeline"></span> | Core single-cell multi-omics, RNA, protein/ADT, ATAC, VDJ, GDO |
| [`openpipeline_spatial`]{.pkg-tag .pkg-openpipeline_spatial}<span class="swatch openpipeline_spatial"></span> | Spatial transcriptomics, ingests Visium, Visium HD, Xenium, AVITI24, CosMx (or any pre-ingested count matrix) |
| [`openpipeline_qc`]{.pkg-tag .pkg-openpipeline_qc}<span class="swatch openpipeline_qc"></span> | Quality-control components and standalone reporting |
| [`openpipeline_rapids`]{.pkg-tag .pkg-openpipeline_rapids}<span class="swatch openpipeline_rapids"></span> | GPU-accelerated drop-ins via rapids-singlecell, *coming soon* |
| [`openpipeline_composed`]{.pkg-tag .pkg-openpipeline_composed}<span class="swatch openpipeline_composed"></span> | Turnkey composed pipelines that wrap the whole flow |

## How the packages relate

Each package plays a role in the overall [process](../workflows/index.qmd):

- **`openpipeline`** defines most stages for ingestion, QC, processing, integration and downstream analysis for RNA, protein, ATAC, VDJ and GDO modalities.
- **`openpipeline_spatial`** contains functionality for spatial transcriptomics (Xenium, Visium, Visium HD, AVITI24, CosMx).
- **`openpipeline_qc`** generates interactive HTML reports for visualising quality control metrics and selecting filtering thresholds.
- **`openpipeline_rapids`** (*coming soon*) provides drop-in GPU replacements for computationally intensive steps using the `rapids-singlecell` package.
- **`openpipeline_composed`** provides end-to-end processing workflows that combine multiple steps.

Each extension package depends on a pinned version of the core package and uses the same [MuData](mudata.qmd) format so components and workflows from different packages can be chained together.

:::{.callout-note appearance="simple" title="External packages"}
`biobox` and `craftbox` are external component libraries that some packages depend on.
These provide generic components for common bioinformatics tools or data manipulation tasks.
:::

Browse every component and workflow across all packages in the [reference](../reference/index.qmd).
